figures.alt: Metal roof drip edge with underlayment and dark shingles at a Florida eave
figures.caption: Sun, salt air, and driving rain expose the drip edge along the lower eave. Inspect the fascia and roof deck before treating it as a simple metal swap.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: Layered roof flashing integrated with asphalt shingles around a curb-mounted skylight
figures.caption: Eave drip edge belongs in a layered water-management sequence. Replacing it later means working existing fasteners and roof layers carefully instead of simply covering the old metal.

figures.alt: Gutter edge, soffit, fascia, and downspout transition at a Florida roof corner
figures.caption: If old metal exposes soft fascia or a spongy roof deck, the scope has changed from a parts swap into a roof-edge repair.
